events.title: Dear Seattle Regional Aus Tour 2026
events.description: Sydney punk rockers Dear Seattle are hitting the road this August, announcing an extensive regional Australian headline tour with very special guests Seahaven (US) who will be making their debut visit to our shores, and Bad Neighbour. Tickets are on sale now via Destroy All Lines With a distinctive Aussie tinge to their emotive and propulsive wares, Dear Seattle are a headbanging-with-heart punk rock band from Sydney’s Northern Beaches. One part mosh pit, and one part love letter, the band have created a truly unique and powerful style of songwriting that’s connecting with fans across Australia and the rest of the world. Whether charming Missy Higgins herself with their 2019 triple j Like A Version of "The Special Two", launching their own beer, burning up the charts and airwaves, or penning melodic, sing along anthems, Dear Seattle are a band who build unforgettable moments with charming execution. Their latest album, TOY (Domestic La La), released last year and marked a major milestone for the band, debuting at #4 on the ARIA Albums Chart and earning Dear Seattle their first ever Top 10 ARIA chart position. Following a massive year of shows all over the world, TOY was re-released earlier this year as an expanded edition featuring two bonus tracks. Joining Dear Seattle on their trek across Australia is Seahaven, an alternative rock band from Torrance, California, known for blending emotionally raw songwriting with melodic, atmospheric guitar-driven music. Over nearly two decades, the band has earned a devoted following through acclaimed releases including Winter Forever, Reverie Lagoon: Music for Escapism Only, Halo of Hurt, and their self-titled 2026 album. With introspective lyrics, dynamic arrangements, and a sound that balances melancholy with soaring hooks, Seahaven continues to evolve while staying true to the honesty that has defined the band from the beginning. With special guests Seahaven (USA), Bad Neighbour and Wifecult. WILL SELL OUT / GET IN EARLY! Doors at 7pm. El Ranchero back deck/bar and Spanish Girl Food Co will be open from 6pm for preshow dinner and drinks. DEAR SEATTLE Mo's Desert Clubhouse (GOLD COAST) Thursday 10 September 2026 // 7pm doors Tickets $59.90 inc BF // 18+ Mo's is Burleigh Heads' most loved music venue, licensed bars, creative studios and cultural hub. The Warehouse & El Ranchero both boast epic bar menus, cocktails and craft beers. Mo's is a fully licensed venue, all guests are required to show ID on entry. Tickets will only be refunded through event cancellation or production of a medical certificate within 24hrs of show doors.

events.title: BLACKEN FOREVER - Nationwide Festival (QLD)
events.description: Blacken Forever is a nationwide celebration of music and solidarity, bringing people together to support the movement to Save The Black Wreath. From the biggest cities to the heart of the Dead Centre, concerts will erupt simultaneously across the country, featuring some of Australia’s best heavy bands. One day, one movement. One shot to Save The Black Wreath. Blacken Forever is a national show of strength, unity and noise. Support the cause to save one of Australia's best heavy festival events. QLD's only Blacken fundraiser event takes place at Gold Coast's Mo's Desert Clubhouse on Saturday 12 September and will feature:\ HELM (rare show) SNAKE MOUNTAIN BLIND GIRLS HOLYSTONE COUCH WIZARD AWFUL NOISE BUNNY RACKET with LAGERSTEIN DJ SET Foodtruck onsite. events.title: Synergy 360° Session
events.description: SYNERGY 360° SESSION IS FINALLY HERE ☆ For one MEGA special, and rare night on the Gold Coast. Our first ever boiler room inspired, 360 session. Where the dancefloor surrounds the booth, where we all become one, connected by the rhythm of sound. ♡︎ This one is HUGE. Synergy welcomes Monika Ross, Ross Weightman AKA ROSSCO, Federico Gonzales, to bless your ear drums. All coming together to provide groovy blends of banging electronic rhythms to take you on a journey. MONIKA ROSS Our headliner, is a widely respected DJ and producer with raw, authentic sounds that move effortlessly through minimal, house, breaks and garage. Fresh from her European tour, we welcome her home. Her dynamic sets and signature sound have led to appearances at some of the most iconic venues worldwide including SASH (Sydney), Fabric (London), Club der Visionaere (Berlin), Watergate (Berlin), PAL (Hamburg), and Oxford Underground (Sydney), among others. ROSS WEIGHTMAN (ROSSCO) Joining her is Ross Weightman AKA ROSSCO, spins house music rooted in deep, funky, progressive grooves, to make you move. He has a big energy you will feel it when he does what he loves! Beyond the booth, you may also recognise him from Love Island Australia! FELIPE GONZALES Opening the journey is FELIPE GONZALEZ, blending the ultimate progressive, organic house with melodic sounds sets shaped by his Argentinian roots. Felipe has the ability of reading the room and shapes his selections around the energy of the crowd. Get here early to watch the magic unfold. This is going to be one for the books. We would love YOU to experience it with us. Limited capacity, don't sleep on it! ONE LOVE ♡︎ Synergy familiiiliaaaa ꩜ Who are Synergy? heeEeelllloooo there :) we’re over the moon you found us. Synergy is an independent music events organiser originating in Bristol, England, that crossed the pond to sunny Straya. A collective built around the power of music to bring people together, to bless your ear drums with incredible music. Our events create high energy spaces, a dance floor where you feel free, a place to let loose, get weird and be you :) A place you feel comfy. Like home. Surrounded by good vibez. With a focus on raw, finely selected electronic music. A little gritty-funky-underground flavour. No commercial ere. You share the same values? come shake a leg. All aboard Synergy kruuuuu!
